name: fix_go_errors_is_wrapped_sentinel
description: Fixes a Go check that uses `==` against a sentinel error that was wrapped with %w; must use errors.Is
prompts: IsMissing in lookup.go should report whether lookup(id) returned a not-found error. lookup wraps the ErrNotFound sentinel with fmt.Errorf("...: %w", ...), but IsMissing compares the returned error with `== ErrNotFound`, which is false for a wrapped error - so genuine misses report false. Fix IsMissing to correctly detect the wrapped sentinel (use errors.Is) while still returning false when there is no error. Keep the function signature and do not change lookup.
